title: A recheck without a queue item forgets the fixes made
what: The cycle script's recheck unit (plugins/delegate/workflows/cycle.js recheckUnit) passes `Fixes: none` to the checker when it gets `findings` and no `items`, so after a branch takes the default branch every finding already fixed on it is judged again with no fix named and comes back NOT MET. A recheck should take the fix report (`fixes`) or the branch's newest check record and carry its verdicts.
why: Live, 28 Oct: wt/rename (a feature with no fix item) took master; recheck rename-after-master returned open 1 and F1, F2, F4 NOT MET though fix-rename.md had fixed them and the check before the merge had them MET. It cost a second checker run (about 19 minutes) and a confirm-fix round. Principle 2: waste that repeats on every feature branch that takes the default branch.
failing_case: Recheck unit {findings: <review>, no items} on a branch whose findings were fixed: the checker prompt says Fixes: none and the verdicts are NOT MET.
pass_cases: A recheck unit accepts `fixes` and passes it to the checker.
Without `fixes`, it passes the branch's newest check record so verdicts already MET are rechecked against their fixes.
A test of the cycle script shows the checker prompt names the fixes.
